review_findings.classification: CONFIRMED CAMPAIGN-RUNNER DEFECT; CORRECTED AND SYNTHETICALLY VERIFIED
review_findings.original_proof: native_clone_probe acquired source_fd then opened parent_fd before entering try. A reachable second-open EMFILE/EACCES leaves source_fd outside any finalizer. This is complete deterministic source proof; no pre-fix executed RED is claimed.
review_findings.correction: Nested try/finally encloses second open and clone; acquired source closes if parent open fails, and both descriptors close if clone fails.
review_findings.regression_proof: Both source-bound tests executed in root actual22. They acquire actual owned FDs, inject second-open EMFILE or clone ENOTSUP, then require fstat EBADF and finally remove the attested owned test root. No native APFS call is made in these tests.
review_findings.counter_evidence: The adapter already used an input-file context around parent open and was not affected. Source failure occurs before worker registration; no unrelated process needs termination.
review_findings.conclusion: Root cause addressed without fallback copies, source mutation, new SDK side effects or application changes.
